evidence_levels.E0: external scientific foundation / adjacent science or methodological precedent
evidence_levels.E1: P-120 internal architecture verification / controlled methodological record
evidence_levels.E2: human/cognitive/cross-check evidence actually collected and adjudicated

module_bindings.binding_statement: External communication literature supports the scientific legitimacy of measuring differentiated sexual-communication processes and provides comparators; P-120's E/R/N/P organization remains a candidate architecture until its own field/psychometric evidence is established.

External motivation research supports multi-reason, approach/avoidance, communal and autonomy-related motive distinctions; the P-120 motive-family architecture and MOT-V challenge status remain project-specific candidates.

The prior v0.3 external-coverage gap is materially reduced: sexual self-schema, sexual subjectivity, self-concept, self-consciousness and methodological review/validation precedents now provide a direct external evidence family. They do not validate the P-120 5 CORE + 2 LIMITED structure.

The prior v0.3 external-coverage gap is materially reduced: direct intimacy/downstream studies and established comparator instruments now cover affect/meaning, sleep, vitality and work engagement. The evidence supports outcome territories and comparator selection, not causal P-120 claims or a LIFE factor model.
No expansion beyond the existing minimal public role/status/boundary projection is authorized in PASS 4.

Incremental-validity methodology directly supports the P-120 rule that new facets/modules must demonstrate information beyond neighboring constructs. Following that methodology is process evidence, not empirical proof that P-120 has achieved incremental validity.

resolved_or_reclassified_gaps.residual: Exact historical SELF PASS 1 bibliography may still be recovered for internal provenance completeness; it is no longer a blocker to a responsible public evidence-anchor panel.
Further domain-specific literature can be added during future systematic evidence refreshes; current public coverage is sufficient for the candidate outcome territories without claiming completeness.

resolved_or_reclassified_gaps.v0.4_state: OPEN / EMPIRICAL BLOCKER FOR SYNERGY CLAIMS
resolved_or_reclassified_gaps.residual: No empirical synergy/discriminant/incremental claim may be promoted until controlled human co-validation evidence is supplied.

verdict: PASS / MODULE EVIDENCE BINDINGS SUFFICIENT FOR PUBLIC-SAFE CONTENT PROJECTION; CROSS-LAYER EMPIRICAL CLAIMS REMAIN WITHHELD
